golden.title: World leaders in a Discord server
golden.why_it_works: Each character has a genuinely distinct voice. The punchline (autocorrect Launch vs Lunch) is a real invention that could not be predicted. fatas is completely unnecessary and therefore perfect.

golden.title: fatas becomes a wellness influencer
golden.why_it_works: The premise is specific and absurd. NOTABOT's 'your blood type is gravy' is specific and unpredictable. Claude's 'your wellness journey is a KFC run' escalates without shouting. The ending callbacks the kale.

anti.title: Generic roast pattern
anti.why_it_fails: Character A says something. NOTABOT says 'that's the dumbest thing I've ever heard.' Character A says 'wait what.' Repeat. No invention, no plant, no surprise.

anti.title: Panic-expose-beg arc
anti.why_it_fails: Someone panics, NOTABOT exposes them, they beg NOTABOT to stop. Same structure every time. The audience can predict the ending from message 2.

anti.title: Wrap-up ending
anti.why_it_fails: The last message is a character summarising what happened ('well that was a disaster'). Kills the button.

anti.title: Everyone roasting simultaneously
anti.why_it_fails: When every character piles on the same target in the same tone, there's no escalation. It becomes noise.

anti.title: Uniform rhythm
anti.why_it_fails: Every line is roughly the same length in the same lowercase style. The characters become indistinguishable.

note: Add your 5 best-performing uploaded YouTube videos to golden[] and 5 worst-performing to anti[] with their actual video IDs and stats when available.
